name: Game Development
note: A portfolio of small projects matters as much as a degree here; many start free with engines like Unity or Unreal. Confirm any course or college details before enrolling.

name: Game Design & Level Design
path: New-age & Creative > Game Design & Level Design
note: Grows from playing, breaking down and re-imagining games; a strong portfolio of designs and prototypes speaks louder than a single qualification.

name: Game Art & Animation
note: Builds on a love of drawing, characters or animation; free tools and online tutorials can take you far before any formal course.

name: Esports & Competitive Gaming
note: Highly competitive and income is uncertain at the top; many players build a parallel path in coaching, casting or content so they are not depending on tournaments alone.

name: Content Creation (YouTube / Instagram)
note: Starts with consistently making things you enjoy; skills in scripting, editing and audience-building compound over time. Income is irregular early on.

name: Video Editing & Motion Graphics
path: New-age & Creative > Video Editing & Motion Graphics
note: A skill you can learn from free tutorials and freelance early; a reel of your edits is your qualification.

name: Digital & Social Media Marketing
path: New-age & Creative > Digital & Social Media Marketing
note: Open to any stream; free certifications and running real (even small) campaigns build the fastest credibility.

name: Startup Founder / Entrepreneurship
note: There is no fixed qualification; it grows from solving a real problem, building skills and starting small. Government support and guidance exist through Startup India.

name: Product Management
note: Usually reached after some experience in tech, design or business; a habit of thinking about how apps and products could be better is the starting signal.

name: UX / UI & Product Design
path: New-age & Creative > UX / UI & Product Design
note: Blends creativity with problem-solving; free tools like Figma and a portfolio of redesigns can open the door without a specific degree.

name: Software / App Development (self-taught route)
note: Many enter through free courses and a project portfolio rather than only a degree; building and shipping small apps is the strongest signal.

name: Writing, Copywriting & Blogging
note: Builds on a love of reading and writing; a public body of work (blog, threads, samples) matters more than a specific stream.
